title: City Attorney report and Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to require Special Event permittees to include public transit…
text:
[Council File 25-0912]
City Attorney report and Ordinance relative to amending the Los Angeles Municipal Code to require Special Event permittees to include public transit information for event attendees in promotional material related to a Special Event.
Fiscal Impact Statement:
No
Community Impact Statement:
Yes
For if amended:
Reseda Neighborhood Council
North Westwood Neighborhood Council
summary: Requiring special event organizers to include public transit information in promotional materials.

outcome.text: Public Works Committee approved as amended (Aug 12, 2026); Council adopted item, subject to reconsideration, pursuant to Council Rule 51 (Aug 25, 2026); Council action final
